title: Operating the Harbor Lift
summary: Instructional reference showing the control panel figure with explicit asset linkage and accessibility hints.

blocks.text: Operators should review the control panel before energizing the harbor lift and confirm the emergency stop is unobstructed.

blocks.caption: Control panel layout with the emergency stop centered below the mode selector.
blocks.alt_text_hint: Annotated control panel showing labeled buttons, status lights, and the red emergency stop.
blocks.description_hint: The red emergency stop sits below the black mode selector and above the row of status lights on the lower panel.
